messages:
Maya CSM: Customer Theta submitted an onboarding request for a 14B contract-summarizer (id: theta-legal-14b). Main constraints: BYOK (AWS CloudHSM), US-WEST-2 data residency, and an eval run on their 5k contract corpus. They
re asking for a pilot in ~3 weeks.

Ravi Sec: Confirmed BYOK via CloudHSM. Need their cluster endpoint, SOC docs, and a network diagram before security signoff.

Zoe Safety: Safety gating items: PII/PHI recall tests, clause hallucination scoring, redaction stress tests. Can they provide 200 de-id contracts for holdout? If not, we'll generate synthetic variants. I'll label the bench `theta_contracts_safety_v1`.

Dmitri ML: Model format? If weights are PyTorch we can stage quickly. Also request: sample inference config from customer (batch, max_tokens).

Maya CSM: They sent a minimal config: `model: theta-legal-14b, format: pt, batch:4, max_tokens:512`.

Hannah Eng: Rollout proposal: security intake (0-3d) -> staging deploy + safety bench (4-9d) -> canary (10-14d) -> pilot monitor (15-21d). Fallback plan -> `redwood-legal-7b` if errors spike. Need expected peak RPS to size GPUs.

Maya CSM: Theta reports peak 28rps, avg 7rps, target p95 <350ms.

Ravi Sec: Creating ticket REDWOOD-ONBOARD-7790 for HSM + compliance intake. Add required artifacts ASAP.

OpsBot: Ticket REDWOOD-ONBOARD-7790 created: https://redwood.example/tickets/REDWOOD-ONBOARD-7790 :white_check_mark:

Zoe Safety: Action items: Maya request 200 de-id docs and 50 high-risk Q&A samples. I'll draft eval checklist once we have samples.

Maya CSM: I'll run weekly checkpoints with Theta and mark renewal (Aug 2026) as "watch" until HSM cleared. Thanks team.
